evaluations.main_cause: working_group answers both parts, though combined labels such as 'Valuation, Youth' must be split before shares are quoted.

evaluations.current_result: 183 of 711 completed projects (25.7%) have at least one accepted publication link.
evaluations.main_cause: The ratio is bounded by the 273-publication corpus and conservative link acceptance, so it understates real output rather than measuring it.

evaluations.current_result: Median 3 years from project start to first linked output (mean 2.86) over the 190 projects that have a dated output link.
evaluations.main_cause: Only 190 of 1,024 projects contribute; the sample is right-censored by corpus coverage, not by real absence of publications.
Ranking is well formed but the counts track which papers were ingested into the 273-publication corpus, so the leaderboard is coverage-driven.

evaluations.current_result: 156 projects marked Completed with end year 2022 or earlier have no accepted publication link.
evaluations.main_cause: A missing accepted link is not evidence that no publication exists; the list is a follow-up queue, not a finding of non-production.

evaluations.current_result: No instrument-family split is derivable; abstract keyword sums (5L EUR 25.2M, Y EUR 10.7M, HWB EUR 9.3M, 3L EUR 5.0M, TIPS EUR 2.6M) overlap to EUR 52.9M against a EUR 51.1M portfolio.
evaluations.main_cause: Projects have no instrument relation, so any split double counts and cannot produce valid shares.

evaluations.current_result: No answer available; projects carry no institution or country attribute, and the 1,933 author affiliation rows are raw source strings across 1,020 distinct values.
evaluations.main_cause: Funding is not linked to normalized institutions or countries anywhere in the serving database.

evaluations.current_result: 'Psychometric properties of the EQ-5D-5L: a systematic review of the literature' (2021), 950 citations, linked as an output of project 2016170.
evaluations.main_cause: Dated OpenAlex counts join cleanly to accepted output links; the retrieval date 2026-08-21 must be stated.

evaluations.current_result: Working-group mix by era shows Valuation falling from 115/191 projects in 2012-2017 to a smaller share by 2018-2022 as Descriptive Systems, Youth and EQ-HWB grow.
evaluations.main_cause: Working group is an organisational unit, not a topic classification, so the trend is a proxy rather than a topical mix.

evaluations.current_result: 1,004 project abstracts are available (average 2,023 characters) but only keyword overlap is possible; no similarity score or ranking can be produced.
evaluations.main_cause: The read-only SQL surface has no embedding or text-similarity function, so 'most similar' cannot be ordered.

evaluations.current_result: 308 of 312 ongoing projects carry abstracts, so candidate overlaps can be surfaced by term, but no aim-level match or ranking is possible.
evaluations.main_cause: Aims are unstructured free text on projects; overlap is judged by the reader, not by the graph.

evaluations.current_result: Per-grant lag is computable, e.g. Nan Luo: 2015410 1 year, 2016230 3, 20170330 4, 20180600 8, 1741-RA 1.

evaluations.current_result: 179 of the 182 completed projects whose abstracts mention a value set have no linked value-set publication.
evaluations.main_cause: 'Promised' is not modelled, so background mentions inflate the numerator while missing links inflate it again; the result is a triage list only.

evaluations.current_result: Valuation methods resolve per country for 26 countries (e.g. Netherlands TTO/cTTO/lead-time TTO/DCE/DCE-with-death/DCE-with-duration; Germany cTTO, DCE, DCE-without-duration, lead-time TTO).
evaluations.main_cause: study_countries and typed method uses work well, but there is no region attribute, so region Y must be assembled by hand.

evaluations.current_result: 10 of 32 projects with -PHD or -SG identifiers (31%) have at least one accepted publication link.
evaluations.main_cause: Grant type is not a field; the cohort is inferred from identifier suffixes and the numerator is bounded by corpus link coverage.

evaluations.current_result: No structured condition or instrument attribute exists on projects; only abstract keyword co-occurrence can be returned.
evaluations.main_cause: Both match dimensions are unmodelled at project level, so shared-attribute retrieval is text-based and unverifiable.

evaluations.current_result: Completed projects by band: under EUR 20k 0.17 publications each, EUR 20-50k 0.35, EUR 50-100k 0.59, EUR 100k+ 1.39.
evaluations.main_cause: Budget and accepted links are both modelled, giving a coherent band comparison with the corpus caveat on link coverage.

evaluations.current_result: 272 of 273 publications carry a DOI, so pasted references can be matched and flagged as EuroQol-funded via support and accepted links; the database itself holds no reference lists.
evaluations.main_cause: Corpus membership testing works on supplied DOIs, but reference lists are deliberately excluded from the serving database.

evaluations.current_result: EQ-5D-5L value sets recorded for about 23 countries including Germany, Egypt, Philippines, Sweden, Taiwan, Romania, Vietnam, Morocco, Denmark, Indonesia, Poland, France, Slovenia, Singapore, Belgium, Hungary, Italy, Peru, UAE, Ghana, Trinidad and Tobago.
evaluations.main_cause: VALUE_SET products join to study countries; 4 of 41 value-set studies lack a country row and the list is corpus-bounded, not the global tally.

evaluations.current_result: EQ-VT use is recorded for around 20 studies, but only EQ-VT 2.0, 2.1 and 2.6.1 are canonicalised; versions 1.0, 1.1 and 'v2' survive only inside free-text source labels.
evaluations.main_cause: Protocol version is not a normalised attribute, so version-by-value-set reporting depends on parsing label strings.

evaluations.current_result: 32 ongoing EQ-HWB projects with named PIs, including valuation-specific work: 1611-RA (Marcel Jonker, EQ-HWB-S pilot valuation, DCE with duration), 1823-RA and 1919-RA (OPUF elicitation).

evaluations.current_result: Publications since 2021 by working group: Valuation 56, Youth 33, Descriptive Systems 32, Valuation+Youth 27, Populations and Health Systems 26.

evaluations.current_result: 14 studies use both EQ-5D-5L and EQ-5D-3L as current activity, including the head-to-head comparisons (V2-P135, V2-P137, V2-P144) and the Hungarian parallel valuation PDF-P018.

evaluations.current_result: 8 population-norms studies and 6 reference-data products; EQ-5D-5L norms cover Germany, Italy, Romania, Trinidad and Tobago and Indonesia, plus one multi-country dataset.
evaluations.main_cause: The purpose and product types are correct, but corpus coverage of national norms is thin, so absence of a country means nothing.

evaluations.current_result: Only 5 studies carry the MAPPING_OR_CROSSWALK purpose, and they are 3L/5L crosswalks, Y-3L DCE-to-TTO mapping and mapped-utility CEA, not condition-specific instrument to EQ-5D mappings.
evaluations.main_cause: The retrieval path is sound but the corpus holds almost none of the specific study class asked about.

evaluations.current_result: Ongoing status is exact (312 projects), but the EQ-5D-5L valuation filter returns 84 abstract keyword hits of which only a few, such as 2247-VS (Turkish EQ-5D-5L value set), are genuine valuation studies.
evaluations.main_cause: There is no project-level instrument or study-type field, so the topical filter is noisy free-text matching.

evaluations.current_result: 9 studies address DCE with duration, including the German 5L value set, PDF-P028 (direct DCE-with-duration versus cTTO comparison), V2-P138 severity-stratified designs and PDF-P041 EQ-5D-Y-5L testing.

evaluations.current_result: 42 of 43 value-set products come from publications marked explicit EuroQol support; only one is unclear and one has no accepted project link.
evaluations.main_cause: The corpus sampling frame is EuroQol-connected by construction, so it cannot supply the non-EuroQol comparison the question requires.

evaluations.current_result: For Nan Luo, grants span 12 working-group labels (Descriptive Systems 14, Education and Outreach 13, Valuation 9, Youth 5 and others); via authorship 7 labels.

evaluations.current_result: 5L valuation studies show analysed samples clustering near 1,000-1,200 respondents (974, 986, 1,000, 1,014, 1,054, 1,158, 1,252) alongside 7,000-12,000 valuation observations.
